instruction: Begin playback of this video stream URL for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_adv_example_hevc/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (advanced HEVC example) with rephrased instruction. Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both required aspects: VLC playback state ('playing') and URL match
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status via HTTP API which contains real-time playback information
Metric (is_vlc_playing) implements comprehensive URL matching logic for HLS streams, including direct match, filename extraction, and domain/path comparison
Expected URL value exactly matches the instruction requirement
No postconfig needed - VLC HTTP status API is accessible during playback
Logic handles edge cases where VLC may show filename instead of full URL for HLS streams
Complete coverage - all instruction requirements are verified
